# Dropdown

A trigger that opens a Menu of actions or single-choice options.

`Icyre.Dropdown` · Overlays

## Use

```jsx
<Icyre.Dropdown trigger={…} items={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Icyre.Dropdown" trigger="{{…}}" items="{{…}}"></x-import>
```
